answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the jetty of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, re-queued for a second panel, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The willow holds work receipts rather than names, so the river of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
